A man is grinning. He grabs onto a box next to him. The idol
is behind him. A kid comes in and steals it.
CUT TO:

priest holds the idol up high. When she does this, she gets
shot by an arrow. The box falls into the water and reaches
the bottom of the sea.
CUT TO:

shows it to the man standing next to him. He hands it to

A traditional dancer dances and worships the idol.
CUT TO:
7 EXT. BAMBOO FOREST - DAY
Two monks are meditating - an older monk and a very young
child. Three people are fighting in front of them, trying to
kill each other. One of them dies and falls at the monk’s
feet. His sword goes through the older monk, killing him. The
child opens his eyes and runs to where the box is. He picks
it up and runs away.
CUT TO:
8 INT. TIBETAN MONASTERY - DAY
The Dalai Lama hands the box to a CIA agent.
CUT TO:
9 INT. CIA OFFICE, USA - DAY
A folder is slammed on a desk. On the folder is written
“Kalpa Vigraha” and scribbled next to it is “27000 years old”
CUT TO:
10 INT. CIA OFFICE, USA - DAY
The box is put inside a chest and is pushed into a shelf. A
giant bar shuts the door close.
CUT TO:
11 INT. CIA OFFICE, USA - NIGHT
The chest is open. There is nothing inside it. Alarms go off,
red lights everywhere buzzing.
12 CREDITS END.
FADE OUT.

He takes out some weed from it, puts it in his chillam, and

14 EXT. ROAD - NIGHT
A fast moving ambassador car on the Hyderabad-Chennai
National Highway is blaring out the song "Gudi yenekka naa
swamy gurram ekkutunte". The three men in the car are
drinking. A green briefcase is beside SURI, a tough looking
goon, who sits in the back.
The car goes faster, the music gets louder, drinks go down,
all of which is interrupted by a heavy thud - the car hits a
divider and flies through the air.
CUT TO:
15 EXT. RUINED TEMPLE - NIGHT
The mute BUM sees the accident and gestures wildly to SURESH.
He turns off the radio and continues gesturing, when SURESH
hits him on the head in an attempt to calm him.
CUT TO:

16 EXT. ROAD - NIGHT
SURESH and the mute BUM are surveying the accident spot - the
two men from the front of the car are dead. The car's
blinking sidelight lights up SURI's bleeding face, who lay on
the road almost dead. SURI barely musters the strength to ask
them for help. The mute BUM wants to, but SURESH stops him,
and points at SURI...or rather his gold ring.
CUT TO:
17 EXT. RUINED TEMPLE - NIGHT
The bums are rummaging through their loot - jewelry, money,
cell phones, and the green briefcase. SURESH opens the
briefcase and finds a curious-looking antique idol. He thinks
it is worthless, and gives it to the mute BUM, grabbing the
rest. The BUM gratefully accepts it, immediately playing with
it like a toy. Police sirens can be heard from the highway.
SURESH is perturbed. He pockets as much loot as possible and
scrambles. The BUM has the idol and the green briefcase with
him.
CUT TO:

enters a vast room which has the FOREST MINISTER, a man in

filled with countless shirt and trousers, the exact same

gets dressed - a tight trouser, an over-sized shirt, wearing
an old-fashioned tie.

A Toyota Fortuner, with the single digit number 9 on its

metal alcohol flask around his neck to go with it. INUMAYYA
has a drink from the flask before going back to sleep.

An old beetle ragtop stands still at a busy traffic signal.
SULOCHANA, a young hipster looking woman, is driving the car.

keys and some barely audible whispers. Someone opens the door
stealthily; three men tip-toe in. They go to the bedside. One
of them switches off the fan, another pulls out a knife and a
lighter. We hear slurping and licking noises. VEDA, in his
20s, wakes up. The lights are turned on, three people scream
“Happy Birthday raa Mama”. VEDA stares at them for five whole
seconds, blinking, trying to make sense of the situation. One
of the three is BHANU, his roommate, wearing torn clothes,
with an empty bottle of whiskey in his hand.
